In this video we cover:
IEX Stock Crashes After Market Coupling Move | Big Shift in India’s Power Trading
IEX shares fell nearly 30% after CERC announced "market coupling"—a new system that will unify electricity prices across all power exchanges in India. This move threatens IEX’s dominance in price discovery and could lead to loss of market share, rising competition, and lower profits. While consumers may benefit from cheaper electricity, IEX’s future now looks uncertain.
